verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents an observability API that returns ordered V4 run events, polled with a cursor, for monitoring a run or building a custom UI. That gives a step-by-step event timeline an engineer could inspect after a run fails. The evidence never mentions recorded video or screenshots, and the live preview is a real-time control view rather than a recorded replay. missing for 10: recorded video replays, per-step screenshots, a documented post-mortem replay/debug UI, explicit failure-debugging guidance, independent or hands-on corroboration.
